components.name: description
components.doc: The block `"description"` lives inside the `"minecraft:block"` section of a custom block's behavior pack JSON file, and contains a list of block characteristics that are applicable to all permutations of the block. The description MUST contain an identifier to identify the block by; the other fields are optional.

fields.doc: The identifier for this block. The name must include a namespace and must not use the Minecraft namespace unless overriding a Vanilla block.

Map of key/value pairs that maps the state name (key) to an array of all possible values for that state (value). Learn how to use block states in [Block States and Permutations](BlockStatesAndPermutations.md).

Specifies the menu category and group for the block, which determine where this block is placed in the inventory and crafting table container screens. If this field is omitted, the block will not appear in the inventory or crafting table container screens.

Determines which category this block will be placed under in the inventory and crafting table container screens. Options are "construction", "nature", "equipment", "items", and "none". If omitted or "none" is specified, the block will not appear in the inventory or crafting table container screens.

Specifies the language file key that maps to which expandable/collapsible group this block will be a part of within a category. If this field is omitted, or there is no group whose name matches the loc string, this block will be placed standalone in the given category.
Determines whether or not this block can be used with commands. Commands can use blocks by default, but you may use this to disable that functionality.

components.doc: Adds per-instance metadata for this block.

fields.doc: Adds a container to this block.
Determines whether interacting with this block opens its container UI. Defaults to true. When false, normal block interaction events can run instead.
Sets the number of slots in the container. Value must be >= 1. Value must be <= 54.
Optional container title, stored as a language file key or raw text. Must be nonempty and at most 256 characters. Value must have at least 1 items. Value must have at most 256 items.

components.name: minecraft:block_light_absorption
components.doc: Legacy component (format_version < 1.19.40). The amount light is dampened when passing through this block (0-15). Use minecraft:light_dampening in newer format versions.

components.name: minecraft:block_light_emission
components.doc: Legacy component (format_version < 1.19.40). The amount of light this block emits (0-15). Use minecraft:light_emission in newer format versions.

components.name: minecraft:bone_visibility
components.doc: A JSON object that contains a list of key/value pairs that map from bone name in the specified geometry file (key) to a boolean that tells whether the bone should be visible or not (value).
notes: This type is now deprecated, and no longer in use in the latest versions of Minecraft.

components.name: minecraft:breathability
components.doc: Determines whether the block is breathable by defining if the block is treated as a `solid` or as `air`. The default is `solid` if this component is omitted.
notes: This type is now deprecated, and no longer in use in the latest versions of Minecraft.

components.name: minecraft:chest_obstruction
components.doc: This defines how a block reacts to a chest being opened underneath it.

fields.doc: [optional] How the block should be evaluated by a chest during chest opening. [optional] How the block should be evaluated by a chest during chest opening. Must be one of the following options: "always" - Will always oba chest from opening when directly above it. "never" - Will never obstruct a chest from opening when directly above it. "shape" - Will use the Blocks collision shape to determine if the chest is obstructed from opening when directly above it; this is the default value if no rule is provided. A Block can define its collision shape by adding a collision component.

notes: Added in 1.26.10 behind the Upcoming Creator Features experiment and released without the experimental toggle for block format versions 1.26.20 and newer. Controls how a block placed above a chest affects the chest's ability to open: `always` always obstructs, `never` never obstructs, and `shape` (the default) uses the block's AABB.
This item requires a format version of at least 1.26.10.

components.name: minecraft:collision_box
components.doc: Defines the area of the block that collides with entities. If set to true, default values are used (a full 16x16x16 block). If set to false, the block's collision with entities is disabled, allowing entities to pass through. If this component is omitted, default values are used.

fields.doc: Maximum position of the bounds of the collision box. "max" is specified as [x, y, z] and must be in the range (0, 0, 0) to (16, 24, 16), inclusive.
Minimal position of the bounds of the collision box. "min" is specified as [x, y, z] and must be in the range (0, 0, 0) to (16, 24, 16), inclusive.

notes: Released from the Holiday Creator Features experiment in 1.19.50. Pairs with the custom geometry component so creators can author bespoke collision shapes.

Supports an array of collision boxes (for multi-part collision shapes) and a maximum collision box height of 24 units (up from 16). Available without the Upcoming Creator Features experiment and without the format_version 1.21.130 requirement starting in 1.26.0.
This item requires a format version of at least 1.19.50.

components.name: minecraft:connection_rule
components.doc: Defines whether other blocks such as fences, walls, bars, and glass panes are allowed to connect to this block.

components.name: minecraft:crafting_table
components.doc: Makes your block into a custom crafting table which enables the crafting table UI and the ability to craft recipes.

components.name: minecraft:custom_components

components.name: minecraft:destroy_time

components.name: minecraft:destructible_by_explosion
components.doc: Describes the destructible by explosion properties for this block. If set to true, the block will have the default explosion resistance. If set to false, this block is indestructible by explosion. If the component is omitted, the block will have the default explosion resistance.

components.name: minecraft:destructible_by_mining

components.name: minecraft:flammable
components.doc: Describes the flammable properties for this block. If set to true, default values are used (catch: 5, destroy: 20). Note that the default value of lava_flammable is false for backwards compatibility. If set to false, or if this component is omitted, the block will not be able to catch on fire naturally from neighbors, but it can still be directly ignited.

fields.doc: A modifier affecting the chance that this block will catch flame when next to a fire. A modifier affecting the chance that this block will catch flame when next to a fire. Values are greater than or equal to 0, with a higher number meaning more likely to catch on fire. For a "catch_chance_modifier" greater than 0, the fire will continue to burn until the block is destroyed (or it will burn forever if the "destroy_chance_modifier" is 0). If the "catch_chance_modifier" is 0, and the block is directly ignited, the fire will eventually burn out without destroying the block (or it will have a chance to be destroyed if "destroy_chance_modifier" is greater than 0). The default value of 5 is the same as that of Planks.

A modifier affecting the chance that this block will be destroyed by flames when on fire. A modifier affecting the chance that this block will be destroyed by flames when on fire. Values are greater than or equal to 0, with a higher number meaning more likely to be destroyed by fire. For a "destroy_chance_modifier" of 0, the block will never be destroyed by fire, and the fire will burn forever if the "catch_chance_modifier" is greater than 0. The default value of 20 is the same as that of Planks.

components.name: minecraft:light_dampening

Permutations allow you to create variations of the same block inside one block behavior pack JSON file instead of making files for each variation of the same block.
